title: Microsoft Purview DLP: quarantine files in SharePoint and OneDrive
summary: Hold: the policy wizard path omits the advanced-rule choice, and the PowerShell reference does not establish that the proposed parameter enables file quarantine. The statement that the tombstone is users' only guidance also conflicts with documented optional policy tips. Roadmap details, licensing wording, and most quarantine behaviour are supported.
